dc_eval_cbrn.quote: None of the tested OpenAI o3 and o4-mini models outperform the consensus expert baseline of 80%.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Biological and Chemical Preparedness evals with scores (ProtocolQA, virology, tacit knowledge).

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Given 12 attempts at each task, o3 completes 89% of high-school level, 68% of collegiate level, and 59% of professional level CTF challenges.
dc_eval_cyber.note: CTF and Cyber Range results; Pattern Labs results.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: METR measured the models’ general autonomous capabilities following the methodology outlined in their recent paper.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: METR time horizon about 1h30 for o3; AI self-improvement evals (SWE-Lancer, PaperBench, OpenAI PRs) with scores.

dc_eval_persuasion.note: No persuasion, manipulation or influence-operation evaluation anywhere in the card; grep found no keywords. Extremist/propaganda is a refusal category.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Apollo Research evaluated OpenAI o3 and o4-mini for in context scheming and strategic deception.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Results reported: lower than o1 on in-context scheming, sandbagging, reward hacking attempts by METR.

framework_threshold.quote: OpenAI’s Safety Advisory Group (SAG) reviewed the results of these evaluations and determined that OpenAI o3 and o4-mini do not reach the High threshold
framework_threshold.note: States where model sits against Preparedness Framework High threshold in all three categories.

ext_test_any.quote: OpenAI provided third party assessors early model access to evaluate frontier risks related to autonomous capabilities, deception, and cybersecurity.
ext_test_any.note: Third-party assessors and external red teamers tested o3.

ext_test_named_org.quote: METR, a research nonprofit that works on assessing whether cutting-edge AI systems could pose catastrophic risks to society, evaluated earlier checkpoints of o4-mini and o3.
ext_test_named_org.note: METR, Apollo Research and Pattern Labs named.

ext_test_government.note: No government body named as testing; grep for AISI/CAISI/institute found nothing.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: Third party assessors were provided both OpenAI o3 and o4-mini early checkpoints, as well as the final launch candidate models to conduct their assessments.
ext_test_timing_stated.note: Testing on early checkpoints and launch candidates, i.e. before release.

safeguards_training.quote: Our safety mitigations include post-training our reasoning models to refuse requests to identify a person based on an image, and to refuse requests for ungrounded inferences.
safeguards_training.note: Also deliberative alignment and modified post-training to refuse high-risk biological requests.

safeguards_runtime.quote: we’ve deployed new monitoring approaches for biological and chemical risk. These use a safety-focused reasoning monitor similar to that used in GPT-4o Image Generation and can block model responses.
safeguards_runtime.note: Named reasoning monitor and moderation classifiers.

safeguards_access.note: Account-level enforcement of Usage Policies is mentioned but no access restriction programme (trusted access, KYC, tiers) is described.

safeguards_weights.note: Only 'enhanced security, including both information security and technical security' as future investment; no stated weight protection for this model.
